{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
df_filtered = df[~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Compute conversion rate by channel, stratified by customer segment
# First, group by channel and segment
conversion_rates = df_filtered.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel (unadjusted)
email_conv = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_conv = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute adjusted conversion rate difference using stratification (weighted average of segment-specific differences)
# Get segment-level counts for weighting
segment_counts = df_filtered['customer_segment'].value_counts()
total_n = len(df_filtered)
segment_weights = segment_counts / total_n

# Compute segment-specific differences in conversion rate (email - paid_search)
differences = []
for seg in segment_counts.index:
    email_rate = conversion_rates[(conversion_rates['channel'] == 'email') & (conversion_rates['customer_segment'] == seg)]['converted'].iloc[0]
    paid_search_rate = conversion_rates[(conversion_rates['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (conversion_rates['customer_segment'] == seg)]['converted'].iloc[0]
    diff = email_rate - paid_search_rate
    differences.append(diff)

# Weighted average difference
adjusted_diff = sum(d * w for d, w in zip(differences, segment_weights))

# Print results
print(f'Email channel conversion rate (unadjusted): {email_conv:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search channel conversion rate (unadjusted): {paid_search_conv:.4f}')
print(f'Unadjusted difference (email - paid_search): {email_conv - paid_search_conv:.4f}')
print(f'Adjusted difference (email - paid_search): {adjusted_diff:.4f}')

# Return adjusted difference
adjusted_diff"}
